SELECT g.*, g.created_at AS history_sort_value
        FROM gift_events g
        WHERE g.source_id = ?
          AND g.detection_status = 'final'
          AND g.status = 'active'
          AND g.total_price > 0
          AND g.num >= 1
          AND (canonicalGiftText(g.gift_id) <> '' OR canonicalGiftText(g.gift_name) <> '')
          AND datetime(g.created_at) IS NOT NULL
          AND g.created_at < ? AND g.created_at = ? AND g.id < ?
        ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT ?
